review: Exceptional battery life and silent operation. Ideal for students and developers who value portability. The M3 chip handles light video editing and coding effortlessly.
A powerhouse for professional creative work. Handles 4K video editing, ML model training and large Xcode builds. The mini-LED display is stunning. Overkill for basic tasks.
The ultimate MacBook. Renders 8K ProRes in real time and handles massive datasets. For most users it is far more than needed, but professionals in video, 3D and ML will not want for more.
Ultra-slim and premium. The OLED display option is gorgeous. Battery life is average for a Windows ultrabook. Best for people who want a compact, stylish Windows machine.
A beautiful machine for creative professionals. The OLED display is class-leading. The discrete GPU handles light gaming and GPU-accelerated creative work. Fans can get loud under load.
Solid budget laptop for everyday tasks. Fine for web browsing, documents and video calls. Not suitable for gaming, video editing or running heavy applications.
The lightest 14-inch business laptop available. Exceptional keyboard, military-grade durability, and excellent battery life. The best Windows laptop for frequent travellers.
A certified mobile workstation. Handles CAD, 3D rendering and ML training. ECC memory support is a plus for engineers. Heavy and pricey, but built for serious workloads.
Great value for money. 16 GB RAM at this price is hard to beat. Good all-rounder for students and home users. The display is adequate but not vibrant.
Top gaming performance at its price. The RTX 4070 handles all current titles at high settings. 240 Hz display feels buttery smooth. Battery life is poor — keep it plugged in.
The best compact gaming laptop. Surprisingly portable for a gaming machine, with decent battery. A rare pick for gamers who also travel or attend lectures.
An OLED display at under $900 is a standout. Slim, light and with good battery life. The display makes photos and video pop. Great for students and light creative work.
HP's most elegant laptop. The 2-in-1 form factor and OLED panel make it a versatile choice. The stylus is included. A strong competitor to the XPS 13 with a better hinge.
Good value with a discrete GPU for creative work and casual gaming. The large display is easy to work on. Build quality is good but not premium. Fans are noisy under load.
Fast, secure and easy to use for cloud-first tasks. Ideal for students using Google Workspace. Not suitable for offline heavy apps or gaming. Best value Chromebook available.
The best Windows laptop for Microsoft ecosystem users. Thin, light, great PixelSense display and long battery life. Limited ports are the only real downside.
The lightest 13-inch Windows device. The detachable keyboard makes it flexible. ARM chip gives great battery life. App compatibility is improving but still behind x86 machines.

The premium gaming laptop. Slim aluminium chassis, excellent display, and top GPU. Commands a big price premium over similarly specced competitors. For buyers who want the best-looking gaming machine.
Remarkable value. Intel Arc GPU handles light gaming and creative tasks. Light enough for daily commutes. The display brightness could be higher. A top budget pick.
One of the fastest gaming laptops available. The RTX 4080 and 240 Hz display are impressive. Heavy and loud. Battery is negligible — this is a desktop replacement.
Stunning AMOLED display and excellent battery life. Pairs well with Galaxy phones. Slim and light. Intel Arc GPU handles light creative work. A top pick for Samsung ecosystem users.
The lightest 17-inch laptop ever made. Under 1.4 kg for a 17-inch display is extraordinary. Battery lasts all day. Best for people who need a large screen but still carry their laptop.

The most repairable and upgradable laptop on the market. Modular ports, replaceable keyboard and screen. Excellent for users who care about repairability and sustainability. Good performance for the price.
Lightweight and premium-feeling Chromebook. Long battery life and a great keyboard. Works best as a companion device or for users fully in the Google ecosystem.
Built for creative professionals. The QHD+ 165 Hz display is class-leading for colour accuracy. 2 TB storage is generous. A direct rival to the MacBook Pro for Windows users who need GPU horsepower.
The best 2-in-1 Windows laptop. Oatmeal leather lid is distinctive, the OLED display is excellent, and the 360-degree hinge works flawlessly. Intel Arc handles light creative tasks well.
Pantone-validated display with near-perfect colour accuracy. Built for professional designers and video editors. The OLED panel and RTX 4060 are a great combination for creative workflows.
Dell's best business laptop. vPro security, 16-hour battery, and sub-1.2 kg weight make it ideal for enterprise users. The build quality is exceptional. A premium corporate machine.
Strong gaming performance at a competitive price. RTX 4070 handles all current titles. The 165 Hz display is smooth. Better value than the ROG or Razer alternatives at this GPU tier.

The best Chromebook for productivity. The 2-in-1 design and sturdy build are impressive at this price. Stylus support and a backlit keyboard are rare at under $600. Good for hybrid school and work use.
